verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Claude Code lets you "run multiple sessions side by side" alongside cloud sessions and diff review, and that the web surface can "run multiple tasks in parallel." Sessions can also be pulled from web or mobile into the terminal via teleport, which together forms a unified multi-session workspace. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how sessions are monitored, switched and managed in that single view (status dashboards, cross-session controls), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the multi-session workspace.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace

citations.quote: Review diffs visually, run multiple sessions side by side, schedule recurring tasks, and kick off cloud sessions.
Kick off long-running tasks and check back when they're done, work on repos you don't have locally, or run multiple tasks in parallel.
Kick off a long-running task on the web or the Claude mobile app, then pull it into your terminal with `claude --teleport`.
Spawn multiple Claude Code agents that work on different parts of a task simultaneously. A lead agent coordinates the work, assigns subtasks, and merges results.
